description: Vehicle makes involved in fatal crashes nationwide for a given year, from NHTSA FARS. Pass year alone to get the top makes ranked by vehicle-involvement count (e.g. "which vehicle makes show up most in fatal crashes in 2023"); pass make as well to get that one make's involvement count across every loaded year. This is an INVOLVEMENT count, not a claim that the make caused the crash. Unknown makes are refused with a clear error naming a few valid makes, never an empty success.

limit.description: Max makes to return when ranking by year. Default 20, max 50.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2023. Required unless make is given (then optional, scoping to one year).

name: fars_vehicle_makes
title: Fars Vehicle Makes
